explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

XXXXX is an english word, which means "trinity" or "triune". it consists of the words trilli and inn, and can be used in combination with the words that can represent the trinity, namely:

trilli: a person or thing possessing the power of trinity; a deity of the trinity; a deity of the trinity.
inn: being part or aspect of a deity of the trinity; a human person (person of the triune).

the term XXXXX in english is one of a long list of terms of the trinity, that is, the three divine beings, or deities, of trinity.
other terms are: trilliam, trilium, trilith, trilliara, trilium, trilliene, trillium, trilliant, trillius, trillium, trillia and trilliam.
the terms of trilia can be found at [wikipedia], but it is written in a peculiar version, which has the words of a human being in it.
the words of a human person are written in a different language than in the version used by the wikipedia. this version is called the standard english
